text_block_list.text:
...Winning Ticket didn't show up for 
training.

She's someone who always puts everything 
into her training. Perhaps something 
happened. I hurriedly went to look for 
her—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
――Yay, I did it~! I finaaaalllly got my 
hands on it~~!!

...I spotted Winning Ticket coming out of 
the sporting goods store in front of the 
station.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, the shopkeeper was so nice, too~♪ I 
totally lost track of time chatting with 
them!
choice_data_list: Aren't you in a good mood?
Aren't you in a good mood?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! You bet! I feel absolutely 
faaantastic~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
After all! It's my absolute favorite 
cycling wear brand...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I managed to get my hands on the 
super-duper-ultra-rare outfit from 
"Two-Five Double" after all~♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't get my hands on it for the 
longest time, but my bike trial buddies 
hooked me up with the info~~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Seeing them in real life, they're so super 
cute! Truly, the "Double" really is the 
greatest!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaaagh!! I cooooompletely forgot about 
it!!!

...I warned Winning Ticket to be more 
careful next time.
